hypothesis: On a frozen finite panel of already-sliding Chrono/TMeasy states, an expanded control library that exactly contains a zero-steer physical-pedal baseline and adds countersteer feedback can strictly enlarge the finite-horizon recovery set under correct physical pedal semantics, matched initial-state hashes, tire truth, speed-preserving recovery, and exact replay.

parent_objective: test the strict post-slip half of the two-regime proposition
replace invalid normalized-pedal recovery audits with correct physical semantics
derived_from: M3266 proves same-plant slide entry from beta zero with 72-frame dwell and exact replay
M3270 satisfies the registered finite pre-slip numerical gate
nested control sets imply weak recovery-set inclusion and a matched witness can establish strictness
blocked_by: universal post-slip recovery and real-vehicle claims remain outside this finite panel
invalidates: treating normalized pedal zero as physical zero
claiming strictness without a matched baseline-fail expanded-success witness

public_gates: freeze cells policies thresholds and disjoint seed streams before quick/full
map physical zero throttle and brake to normalized minus one
keep every baseline policy in the expanded policy set
use no simultaneous pedal candidates and make no ESC claim
require configured initial beta and yaw match plus four-wheel rear-slip truth
count recovery only after ten stable frames with forward speed at least 4 m/s
do not count collision spin or stopping sideways as recovery
require matched initial hashes and exact winner replay
require at least six robust strict full cells spanning both signs and two beta tiers
scope support to the selected finite states and policy libraries
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use normalized zero as a physical zero pedal command
do not call uniform braking ESC or claim individual-wheel braking
do not remove baseline candidates from the expanded set
do not change cells policies thresholds seeds or success rules after results
do not count stopping sideways or low-speed settling as recovery
do not use old audit counts as evidence
do not mutate ActiveSafetyReflexDriver or train a policy
do not claim all post-slip states all no-steer controls real cars promotion or self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: 18 mirrored initialized-slide cells with 30 nested physical policies and three fresh seeds
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: selected initialized slide states and frozen finite policy libraries on Chrono/TMeasy
stop_condition: stop before full if either mirrored quick state lacks a healthy strict witness
stop as inconclusive on any state-match tire nesting row-count or replay failure
stop as no-strict-witness when health passes but the robust strict threshold fails
admit finite strict support only when all frozen gates pass
fallback_plan: if H1 fails, retain only weak set inclusion from nested controls and report no strict simulator witness
if H1 passes, update the theory certificate and paper with finite-scope post-slip strict evidence
preserve all baseline successes failures and active failures at full fidelity

self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Every baseline recovery active failure state mismatch and failed strict cell remains visible.
allowed_claims: weak inclusion from exact policy-set nesting
no strict witness if the threshold fails

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: introduces corrected physical pedal semantics and exact nested-control recovery-set adjudication on mirrored slide states
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: A healthy result can support the selected-state strict post-slip complement to the bounded pre-slip theorem.
must_synthesize_if: quick fails and a policy or threshold change is proposed
the expanded set omits a baseline candidate
a low-speed stop is relabeled recovery

success_criteria: preregistration freezes 18 full cells 30 policies and seed streams before quick/full
both mirrored quick cells are healthy strict witnesses
managed resumable full completes 1620 candidate rows and 36 exact winner replays
all state-match nesting tire-truth finite-observation and weak-inclusion gates pass
at least six cells are strict on all three seeds spanning both signs and two beta tiers
old invalid audit counts and finite claim scope remain explicit
failure_criteria: physical and normalized pedal semantics are conflated
baseline and expanded initial states differ
a stopped or colliding trajectory is counted as recovered
strict support is claimed without robust matched witnesses
decision_rule: Return strict_recovery_expansion_support only when all health and weak-inclusion gates pass and at least six of eighteen full cells are strict on all three fresh seeds with both signs and at least two beta tiers represented. Return no_strict_witness when health passes but that threshold fails. Otherwise return inconclusive.
